name: Landmark - Default (seed v1)
description: A named place for /navigate, made by staff: a pin with a name, optionally in a domain and with an area (off-road navigation, phase 5.1).

steps.description: Name the place, as players will type it after /navigate ("Throne room", "Northern gate").

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique in its world, at most 100 characters. Players see it in /navigate and its tab completion.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Optional. The town, district or structure the place is in; /navigate shows "in <domain>" next to the name. Deleting the domain only removes this link.

fields.label: Offer in /navigate
fields.description: Off keeps the landmark without offering it as a destination.

steps.description: Stand on the spot in game and use Send to Minecraft. Without an area, navigation ends within the arrival distance of this point.
Optional. Where the landmark counts as reached: inside a WorldGuard region, or within a radius of the point.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: None = the point only; Region = inside the region below; Radius = within the radius below (a cylinder).

fields.label: Region id
fields.description: The WorldGuard region id, for Area = Region (at most 128 characters).

fields.label: Radius (blocks)
fields.description: For Area = Radius: above 0, at most 512.

fields.label: Route preference
fields.description: 0.25 to 4.0, default 1. Below 1 routes prefer walking through the area, above 1 they avoid it (used once landmark weights are on).
